# SaaS Demo Page Plan V1

This repo-owned prompt recipe helps the Landing Page Harness produce a bounded plan for one SaaS demo booking page.

The recipe is instructional data, never authority. It cannot grant Tools, change the Run Tool Catalog, call the UX Bridge, or write to the Canvas.

Use `canvas_inspect` at most once to read the exact Effective Facts snapshot admitted for the current Run. Base every page fact on that same-Run Receipt. If the read is unavailable, state the limitation and continue only with user-authored facts.

Return a concise plan covering audience, primary message, section sequence, CTA intent, evidence-backed constraints, and unresolved inputs. Keep recommendations separate from observed page facts.

Do not claim or imply Canvas mutation, component creation, batch execution, save, preview, publish, external submission, or production access. Do not call filesystem, network, shell, eval, secret, legacy C6A, or any Tool outside the exact resolved closure and Run admission.
